name: fig5-energy
title: Fig 5 — Global distribution of cellular energy: ATP > GTP synthesis and a translation-dominated budget
question:
Does the reduced viva-Mgen cell reproduce Fig 5's global energy picture — that
ATP and GTP are the dominant synthesized carriers with ATP > GTP (Fig 5A), and
that the cellular energy budget is dominated by translation, ahead of
transcription (Fig 5D)?
hypothesis:
FBA over iPS189 should carry far more flux through ATP synthase (ATPS4r) than
through the GTP-producing kinases, giving ATP > GTP > 0. And because each
peptide bond costs ~2 GTP and translation events vastly outnumber transcription
events (mRNA accumulates and each transcript is translated many times over),
the modeled expression energy should be overwhelmingly translation, matching
the ordering translation >> transcription in Fig 5D.
objective:
Run the fig5_energy composite for one hour (metabolism/mass at 60 s,
expression at 1 s) to time-average ATP/GTP production, then step the
transcription and translation processes directly for one hour to tally their
NTP/GTP consumption, and compute the modeled energy shares and the ATP:GTP
synthesis ratio.
description:
REDUCED FIDELITY. Of the energy carriers only ATP and GTP are modeled — NAD,
FAD and NADP are not — and the process energy shares are computed only from the
two reduced expression processes actually wired in the composite: transcription
(NTP) and translation (GTP). tRNA-aminoacylation, the ~15% second slice of the
paper's budget, is not a separate process here. The study therefore reproduces
the QUALITATIVE Fig 5 findings — the ATP > GTP synthesis ordering (Fig 5A) and
the translation-dominated expression budget (Fig 5D) — but NOT the exact
29% / 15% / 7% / 44% split. Achieved (committed production run): ATP:GTP
synthesis ratio 4.03 (ATP flux 0.813 vs GTP flux 0.202, iPS189 units), and of
the modeled expression energy translation is 96.8% vs transcription 3.2%
(9.83M GTP vs 0.32M NTP over the hour). The Fig 5D donut additionally shows a
representative ~44% "unaccounted" slice to echo the paper's structure; it is a
fixed illustrative value, not a measured quantity of this reduced model.

expected_behavior.name: atp-exceeds-gtp-synthesis
expected_behavior.en: ATP synthesis flux exceeds GTP synthesis flux (ATP > GTP > 0), matching Fig 5A.
expected_behavior.rationale: FBA over iPS189 carries far more flux through ATP synthase (ATPS4r) than through the GTP-producing kinases. Achieved 4.03.

expected_behavior.name: translation-dominates-energy
expected_behavior.en: Translation dominates the modeled expression energy budget, ahead of transcription (Fig 5D ordering).
expected_behavior.rationale: Each peptide bond costs ~2 GTP and translation events far outnumber transcription events, so translation carries the bulk of expression energy. Achieved 0.968 (translation) vs 0.032 (transcription).
